decisions.rationale: Dragapult (Ghost) immune to Raichu Fake Out, outspeeds most foes; Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert-Mega, threatens Pelipper/Basculegion, snowballs with Contrary. Talonflame provides priority Tailwind for speed control (mind Tsareena's Queenly Majesty). Incineroar Intimidate weakens physical rain sweepers and pivots with Parting Shot. Bench Gardevoir-Mega (Flash Cannon weak) and Appletun (too slow).
decisions.notebook: Rain mode: Pelipper (Damp Rock, Wide Guard, Hydro Pump, Weather Ball, Tailwind), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, Earthquake, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect), Basculegion (Choice Scarf + Swift Swim 3x speed under rain; Last Respects, Wave Crash, Flip Turn, Phantom Force), Archaludon (Electro Shot in rain is one-turn with SpA boost; Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect, Sitrus Berry). Tsareena and Raichu are the remaining bench; likely brought in game 2. Pelipper's Wide Guard only blocks spread moves; Taunt on it denied future Wide Guard attempts. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKO's Swampert-Mega, possible OHKO on Pelipper (59-118%) and Basculegion (86-156%); Dragon Pulse at +2+ can KO Archaludon. Talonflame's Focus Sash broken by its own recoil. Archaludon Electro Shot does ~64% to Serperior (resisted) and OHKO's 84% Talonflame. Combined Dragapult Shadow Ball + at least +2 Serperior Dragon Pulse always KO's Archaludon under Tailwind. Dragapult (213 Spe) speed-ties Basculegion Scarf (160-214); under rain Swampert-Mega (180-244) and Basculegion (214-286) can outspeed. Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks priority including Talonflame Tailwind and Fake Out. Raichu Lightning Rod redirects Electric; Focus Sash.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper sets Drizzle, enabling Swampert to mega evolve and outspeed with Swift Swim, while Basculegion and Archaludon provide high-power rain-enabled backup in the back against Talonflame and Serperior.
decisions.notebook: Serperior runs Contrary with Life Orb (Leaf Storm, Dragon Pulse, Protect, Glare). Talonflame runs Gale Wings with Focus Sash (Tailwind, BraveBird, Taunt, Protect). Gardevoir runs Gardevoirite (Pixilate). Appletun runs Thick Fat (Apple Acid, Recover, Leech Seed, Protect). Dragapult runs Clear Body with Expert Belt (Shadow Ball, Flamethrower, Will-O-Wisp, Protect). Incineroar runs Intimidate with Sitrus Berry (Parting Shot, Flare Blitz, Darkest Lariat, Protect).

decisions.rationale: Pelipper has no Protect; double-targeting it with Leaf Storm (59-118%) + Shadow Ball (34-67%) gives 93-185% combined, almost certainly KOing before it can Tailwind. Serperior gets +2 SpA from Contrary regardless. Swampert-Mega may Ice Punch Dragapult (68-96%) but can't OHKO. Removing their speed control and rain pivot while boosting Serperior to +2 wins the long game even if Dragapult takes chip.

decisions.rationale: Brave Bird (12.2–21.2%) + Dragon Pulse (91.9–177%) = minimum 104.1% combined, guaranteed KO before Archaludon can act. Both moves outspeed Archaludon. Even if Archaludon Protects, the same sequence wins next turn. No Protect from Talonflame needed—Protect success is reduced and recoil threat is irrelevant with the game on the line.

Dragapult Flamethrower 17–43% is an inferior bench option into Archaludon. Incineroar remains frozen; Flare Blitz thaws on use. Rain has ~4 turns remaining.

decisions.rationale: Basculegion is fainted so slot 1 must pass. Archaludon has Electro Shot charged and ready to release; targeting Talonflame guarantees an OHKO (super-effective) through its Focus Sash since Electro Shot goes off instantly and Talonflame cannot protect twice in a row safely or survive.

reflections.summary: We won the series 2-0 by deploying a Serperior-centric anti-rain lead that removed Pelipper immediately, denying their weather-dependent speed control and allowing Serperior to snowball with Contrary Leaf Storm. Between-game adjustments to focus on this opening were decisive; our preparation accurately identified Serperior as the win condition and the need to bypass Wide Guard with single-target moves.
reflections.adjustment: Maintain the same six and the aggressive Dragapult+Serperior lead against future rain setups. Consider swapping Incineroar’s Sitrus Berry for a Lum Berry if freeze from Ice Punch reappears, though Flare Blitz already thaws on use. Appletun could substitute for Dragapult if bulkier Grass support is desired, but Serperior’s speed and boosting remain superior.
reflections.notebook: Opponent relies on Damp Rock Pelipper + Swift Swim sweepers (Mega Swampert, Scarf Basculegion) + Archaludon; backup choices are Raichu and Tsareena. Priority: snipe Pelipper early with single-target special attacks—Wide Guard does not block. Serperior’s Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert and Basculegion after one boost; Archaludon falls to Brave Bird chip + Dragon Pulse. Incineroar’s Intimidate cycle weakens physical hits; Talonflame’s priority is shut down by Tsareena, so remove it first. Basculegion often locks into Last Respects, making Protect stalling predictable. Rain team lacks backup weather, so removing Pelipper cripples their speed advantage. Swampert commonly Protects turn 1 to Mega Evolve safely.

reflections.summary: The series and game were lost because the opponent's Serperior capitalized on Contrary with unhindered Leaf Storm boosts, swiftly dismantling the Pelipper and Mega Swampert rain core on turn 1 and 2 before any offense could be established. Bringing Pelipper and Mega Swampert into Dragapult and Serperior proved fatal, as the opponent's speed control and offensive pressure outpaced the rain setup. Preparation featured a standard rain structure that lacked sufficient speed control outside of Drizzle Swift Swim and failed to pressure or shut down Serperior's setup potential.
reflections.adjustment: For a future rematch, bring faster disruption or Taunt support to prevent Serperior from freely clicking Leaf Storm, and consider Altaria or defensive pivots from the draft roster instead of forcing a linear Rain archetype into a severe Contrary disadvantage.
reflections.notebook: Serperior utilizes Contrary with Leaf Storm and Life Orb to quickly attain +6 Special Attack. Talonflame provides priority Tailwind and Protect utility. Dragapult pressures rain leads effectively with high-damage Ghost output.
